ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The attached figure is a schematic diagram of China’s Yellow River Delta. It can be seen that the Yellow River extends toward the Bohai Sea near its estuary, and a delta form protruding toward the sea is formed at the river mouth. The figure also marks spatial backgrounds such as the Bohai Sea, Laizhou Bay, Dongying City, and latitude and longitude lines. Reasoning: The question stem asks why “reservoirs are built on the main and tributary streams, intercepting and storing large amounts of ____” would cause the growth rate of the land area of the Yellow River Delta to be slow. The growth of delta land mainly relies on rivers carrying sediment to the river mouth and depositing it to create land; if reservoirs are built upstream and on tributaries, large amounts of sediment are intercepted in the reservoir areas, the sediment transport volume downstream decreases, sediment deposition at the river mouth decreases, and the expansion of the delta will become slower. Therefore the blank should be filled with “sediment”.
